philippines.description:

philippines.title: Sara Duterte's impeachment trial: Article IV highlights
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel on Wednesday concluded its presentation of Article IV, which accuses Vice President Sara Duterte of making grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos and former Speaker Martin Romualdez. The prosecution’s presentation was completed in 9 days, despite being given a total of 11 days to present their evidence. Though it should be noted that, technically, it only took six days for the court to tackle Article IV as three days were spent on other matters.
